decision.reason: The entire unchanged 11bea profile can genuinely be met from supplied species/formulas, ion charges and atom/electron conservation without mastering the whole separate constant-product-mass data normalization and excess-reactant competence. A related useful teaching concept is insufficient for a global hard mastery frontier.

countercase.baseline: For supplied Mg, Cl2, MgCl2 and supplied half-equation species, balance atoms/electrons and retain the stipulated species identity; explain that replacing MgCl2 by MgCl changes the given substance. This does not require normalizing the separate 4:1 CuO data.
countercase.freshTransfer: For supplied Al/Al3+/AlCl3 and Ca2+/Ca(OH)2, derive correct smallest-integer atom/charge balanced equations. A learner can do both while still failing the separate FeS 7:4 pure-product versus 14:4 reactant-mixture/excess interpretation.
countercase.noProfileRewrite: No formula identification from empirical unknown mass data or quantitative yield task is added to 11bea to manufacture prerequisite necessity.

distinctions: Mass conservation is not fixed mass composition.
Fixed formula identity and counting atoms are not identical to the whole e0d numerical product-mass/excess assessment.
A possible teaching sequence is not sufficient evidence for a mandatory whole-prior mastery gate.

dependentSourceRouteDecisions.reason: The J10 column concerns atom conservation and constant atom-number ratios in given species; it does not make the whole CuO/FeS product-mass/excess routine a necessary prior to balancing supplied formulas. The dependent requires-closure route has no accepted necessary literal edge.

The equation component is separable from the obligatory metal/water DE/SE strand. Supplied symbolic equations neither conduct those experiments nor require the whole mass-ratio data competence. The dependent requires-closure route has no accepted necessary literal edge.

TF3 combustion equation/model representation does not require mastering the separate pure-product mass-ratio and excess-data routine; actual experiment operators remain separate. The dependent requires-closure route has no accepted necessary literal edge.

The source expressly permits word schemes OR formula notation. A global numeric constant-composition prerequisite cannot be promoted into official formula-only or law mastery. The dependent requires-closure route has no accepted necessary literal edge.

Correct Klasse9 p18 derives reaction equations using valency and reaction schemes. The author incorrectly supplied Klasse8 p18; corrected original still does not require the whole numeric e0d routine. The dependent requires-closure route has no accepted necessary literal edge.

Equations for nonmetal oxides and atomic rearrangement are distinct from the separately named experimental confirmation of mass conservation and from fixed product mass proportions. The dependent requires-closure route has no accepted necessary literal edge.

Deriving oxide formulas/equations and modeling molecule structures does not imply the supplied-product mass-normalization/excess routine. Mandatory experiments remain unperformed by these paper tasks. The dependent requires-closure route has no accepted necessary literal edge.

Oxidation word/formula equations, valency and particle bookkeeping do not require the entire CuO/FeS mass-data routine. Neither oxygen tests nor burning experiments are claimed performed. The dependent requires-closure route has no accepted necessary literal edge.
